records.claim: Every pregnancy starts out with a 3-5% chance of having a birth defect. This is called the background risk. Most available information suggests that the use of montelukast in pregnancy does not increase the chance of birth defects above the background risk. Medical record reviews of thousands of pregnancies reportedly exposed to montelukast did not find an increased chance of birth defects. Other studies looking at a combined total of over 200 pregnancies exposed to montelukast have not suggested an increased chance of birth defects.
records.source_section: Does taking montelukast increase the chance of birth defects?
